notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33587473/9b1e1aa6c58fddf8fe77b500396f01da0e4e9e22.png

Development update 2.

Hello Survivors!

Alpha 5.93 is now deployed on the Steam Alpha branch.
I added multiplayer to the creative mode, so now you can play creative mode with your friends.
I also added the first batch of creative blocks so you can spawn infected and mutants in creative mode.
When you start a (local) multiplayer server it will be visible from the server list, anyone with the same game version can join. I can't wait to see what you create.
Switching from single player to creative mode is now fixed.
Just switch to the alpha branch if you want to try it out. Remember to press K to toggle the creative menu.

Stay safe!
Zouking

notes.title: Development update.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33587473/9b1e1aa6c58fddf8fe77b500396f01da0e4e9e22.png

Development update.

Hello Survivors!

We are almost done testing multiplayer creative mode, You will be able to invite friends to join your creative session, with the option to prevent other players from spawning items.

I am also testing new creative blocks that you can place on the map to create game-play scenarios, like spawning infected and mutants, spawning hordes, loot chests, quests, missions and others.

I am preparing several creative mode maps with different sizes to choose from, If testing goes well, they could be included in the next update.

There is a closed public testing phase coming, be sure to request access on the community discord to try it out

PVP scenarios could also be coming to creative mode, Its still work in progress, I will post more detail soon!

Let me know what you think.

You can join the community discord to follow the development.
https://discord.gg/nHSSf2G97D

Your continued support keeps the game development moving forward, thank you!

Stay safe!
Zouking

notes.title: Alpha 5.53 Hotfix 7
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!

Another patch to stabilize and optimize the game!

In this patch, I added the block replacement system using the wrench for 3x3x1 foundations, 1x1x1 blocks, 3x3x1 walls and floors, basically you can interchange same size blocks using the wrench, just slide the block into slot 6 and hit the block you want to replace, plan your block replacement well, cause you lose the old block when you replace it. Other blocks will be added in future updates.

If you hear wolves howling, get to safety, mutants wolves are seen in zone 2, fast and deadly, be prepared when venturing beyond the wall.

Thanks to the community feedback I manged to locate and fix the memory leak causing the game to crash in single player.

I am also putting in place compensation code to prevent issues caused by latency spikes. 
Spawning on other players beds, previously removed beds showing up on server restart and spawning level 1 due save not found on high latency networks , is now fixed!

If you are enjoying the game , be part of the amazing community  and talk to us, we are always on the discord Road to Eden Discord

Known issue: Because of the new block replacement system I had to reorient the paintable concrete floor. If you have paintable concrete floors in your base that are misoriented , just remove them with a crowbar and place them again. Removing the paintable concrete floors will not collapse your structure, for now!

Stay safe everyone, cheers!

notes.title: Road to Eden Development update 001
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587473/3adfd88b7b5dc8fb325de5af353cd3027d25fa25.jpg

Hello Survivors!

I know it has been a few weeks since we released an update, as a result I have decided to start a development update to keep you informed on what is being developed in the pipeline.

We have been hard at work to bring you the new dedicated servers system!
We are almost done working on a system that will enable you to host your own dedicated server on a separate computer,  join a dedicated server and  host or join a game hosted on your local computer.

We will also setup an official dedicated server soon after the release.
A new game is required after the update as previously saved games will not be compatible with the new system.

We have also upgraded the build system and added new blocks. The new building system will enable players to build without being restricted to grids, rotate blocks 45 deg and automatically snap blocks to other blocks

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33587473/0716e2449de67c73f76a33662cc4d4d13d06193a.jpg
Once we release Alpha 4.0, we will start working on claims, door locks, drivable vehicles, more player capacity on servers and a clan system, in preparation for the large map that will only be available on dedicated servers.
We are also preparing new block tiers, and new block forms and designs that will be announced in future development updates.

See you all in-game

Join our discord community to know more https://discord.gg/THWCJnG
